verdict: Leads are up and cost per lead is improving — pipeline intake needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 87 leads from Meta at $24.04 per lead, and the most recent 7-day stretch shows leads up 5.56% with cost per lead improving 4.85% on essentially flat spend — efficiency is genuinely moving in the right direction. The top campaign is anchoring the majority of that output and performing well. One area that needs immediate attention: roughly 17 of those 87 leads do not appear to have entered your intake pipeline, which points to a hand-off gap rather than an ads issue. We're auditing the intake flow this week to close that gap so every lead you're paying for gets followed up. Google Business Profile action tracking also dropped sharply this week and is being investigated — that number currently under-reports your organic visibility, not your actual foot traffic or calls.
